column2: Feeling Your Years
The Body Argues
Frail
Ancient
The First Cold Morning

I noticed it in the training yard, of all places. The form I have thrown ten thousand times came slower today, and the young ones finished before me, not by a step, but by enough that they pretended not to notice.\n\nSixty winters. I have never counted them before.
Let the young take the lead
I will out-work them yet
Hair Like Ash

The mirror, when I bother with it, shows a stranger: grey at the temples, and lines that were not there when I last counted.\n\nA long line of Avatars looks back at me from behind my own eyes, and not one of them is young either.
Sit with the spirits a while
There is still work to do
The Mountain Is Further Than It Was
The path to the temple used to take me half a day. I made it by dusk this time, and had to sit at the top with my heart hammering like a drum.\n\nSeventy. The mountain has not moved. I have.
Climb it anyway
Let someone else make the climb
I Have Outlived My Friends

Another letter, another funeral. I have stopped counting the faces at the back of my memory. They die, and I remain, and the world keeps asking me to be the one who remembers.\n\nThe young ones think I am lucky. I have stopped trying to explain.
Make peace with the dead
Build something that will hold
The Spirits Stand Close

They come to me now without being called. In the half-sleep before dawn I see them plainly: the ones I loved, the ones I failed, the ones whose lives I borrowed.\n\nThey do not speak. They only wait, and I have begun to understand what they are waiting for.
I am ready. Let them come.
Not yet. There is more to do
The cycle will come for you sooner.
One Last Journey

Eighty-five. There is one place left that I want to see with these eyes while they still see: the place where it began, wherever that was for this life of mine.\n\nThe road is long, and I am not what I was. But I have never once let that stop me.
Go. See it one last time
Stay. There is peace enough here
I have seen enough. I am ready.
The Long Sleep

It comes for me in the night, and it is not unkind. My breath slows, the room grows far away, and behind my eyes the whole line of them is standing, every Avatar who ever was, waiting to take my hand.\n\nThere is a door here. I can feel it. I have only to decide whether to open it.
Let go. Trust the cycle.
I am not finished.
You Wake, Weaker
Dawn. Someone has been sitting with me all night, and by their face I must look as bad as I feel.\n\nThe door is still there. I did not open it. It will wait.
Rise, and get on with it
The Long Sleep Returns

It comes again, and this time there is no negotiation in it. The line of Avatars is closer than before, and the door stands open of its own accord.\n\nI have had my extra years. That will have to be enough.
Go, then. It is time.
